learn.rule: Ask who, what, when, where, and why. Each answer adds a detail and makes the sentence stronger.
learn.ruleEs: Pregunta quién, qué, cuándo, dónde y por qué. Cada respuesta agrega un detalle y fortalece la oración.
learn.model: Canada geese fly south in the fall to find warmer weather.
learn.notice: The kernel is Geese fly. Each added detail answers a question: where (south), when (in the fall), why (to find warmer weather).

items.prompt: Which question does the detail in the fall answer about the geese?
items.text: Geese fly south in the fall.
items.why: In the fall tells the time, so it answers When?
items.whyEs: In the fall dice el tiempo, así que responde When? (cuándo).

items.prompt: Which question does the detail to find warmer weather answer?
items.text: Many birds fly south to find warmer weather.
items.why: To find warmer weather gives the reason birds fly south, so it answers Why?
items.whyEs: To find warmer weather da la razón por la que las aves vuelan al sur, así que responde Why? (por qué).

items.prompt: Check every detail that tells where the bats hunt.
items.why: Where details name a place, like over the quiet pond. At dusk tells when, and by using echoes tells how.
items.whyEs: Los detalles de dónde nombran un lugar, como over the quiet pond. At dusk dice cuándo y by using echoes dice cómo.

items.prompt: Choose the detail that tells when the salmon swim.
items.model: The salmon swim upstream each fall to lay their eggs.
items.why: Each fall is a time, so it answers When? The other choices tell where and how.
items.whyEs: Each fall es un tiempo, así que responde When? Las otras opciones dicen dónde y cómo.

items.prompt: Which is the strongest expansion of the kernel sentence Whales sing?

options.text: Humpback whales sing long, haunting songs in warm waters every winter.

items.why: This sentence answers who (humpback whales), what (long songs), where (warm waters), and when (every winter).
items.whyEs: Esta oración responde quién (humpback whales), qué (canciones largas), dónde (aguas cálidas) y cuándo (every winter).

items.prompt: Choose the detail that tells when, then the detail that tells where.
items.model: Tiny tree frogs sing after a heavy rain in the wet forest.
items.why: After a heavy rain tells when, and in the wet forest tells where. Together they make a stronger sentence.
items.whyEs: After a heavy rain dice cuándo e in the wet forest dice dónde. Juntos hacen una oración más fuerte.

write.prompt: Expand the kernel sentence. Tell when and where, and add a reason if you can.
write.promptEs: Expande la oración base. Di cuándo y dónde, y agrega una razón si puedes.
write.model: The hungry seal dives deep into the cold ocean every morning to catch fish for her pup.

familyTalk.en: Pick a simple sentence like 'The dog barked.' Take turns adding when, where, and why.
familyTalk.es: Elijan una oración sencilla como 'The dog barked.' Túrnense para agregar cuándo, dónde y por qué.

teacherTip.en: Post the five question words and have students point to each one as they add a detail to the kernel.
teacherTip.es: Muestra las cinco palabras de pregunta y pide que los estudiantes señalen cada una al agregar un detalle a la oración base.

learn.rule: Ask who, what, when, where, and why. Each answer adds a detail and makes the sentence stronger.
learn.ruleEs: Pregunta quién, qué, cuándo, dónde y por qué. Cada respuesta agrega un detalle y fortalece la oración.
learn.model: Farmers sold vegetables in the town square before the sun rose.
learn.notice: The kernel is Farmers sold vegetables. In the town square tells where. Before the sun rose tells when.

items.prompt: Which question does the detail in the town square answer about the farmers?
items.text: Farmers sold vegetables in the town square.
items.why: In the town square names a place, so it answers Where?
items.whyEs: In the town square nombra un lugar, así que responde Where? (dónde).

items.prompt: Which question does the detail before sunrise answer about the bakers?
items.text: Bakers lit their ovens before sunrise.
items.why: Before sunrise tells the time, so it answers When?
items.whyEs: Before sunrise dice el tiempo, así que responde When? (cuándo).

items.prompt: Check every detail that tells why the villagers built a stone bridge.
items.text: Kernel sentence: The villagers built a stone bridge.

options.text: so carts could cross the river
because the old bridge washed away

items.why: Why details give a reason. Last spring tells when, and near the mill tells where.
items.whyEs: Los detalles de por qué dan una razón. Last spring dice cuándo y near the mill dice dónde.

items.prompt: Choose the detail that tells who counted coins.
parts: counted their coins after a long day.
items.model: The tired merchants counted their coins after a long day.
items.why: The tired merchants names who did the action. The other choices tell when and where.
items.whyEs: The tired merchants nombra a quien hizo la acción. Las otras opciones dicen cuándo y dónde.

items.prompt: Which is the strongest expansion of the kernel sentence Children played?

options.text: Children played in the dusty street while their parents shopped at the market.

items.why: This sentence adds where (in the dusty street) and when (while their parents shopped), so the reader can picture it.
items.whyEs: Esta oración agrega dónde (in the dusty street) y cuándo (while their parents shopped), así que el lector puede imaginarla.

items.prompt: Choose the detail that tells where, then the detail that tells when.
items.model: Street musicians played drums in the crowded square every Saturday.
items.why: In the crowded square is the place, and every Saturday is the time. Both add information the reader wants.
items.whyEs: In the crowded square es el lugar y every Saturday es el tiempo. Los dos agregan información que el lector quiere.

write.prompt: Expand the kernel sentence. Tell when and where, and add a reason if you can.
write.promptEs: Expande la oración base. Di cuándo y dónde, y agrega una razón si puedes.
write.model: The happy crowd cheered in the town square after the parade ended because the band played their favorite song.

familyTalk.en: Describe a place your family goes often. Say who is there, what they do, when, and where.
familyTalk.es: Describan un lugar al que va su familia con frecuencia. Digan quién está allí, qué hacen, cuándo y dónde.

teacherTip.en: Write the kernel and add one detail at a time, asking the class which question each new detail answers.
teacherTip.es: Escribe la oración base y agrega un detalle a la vez; pregunta a la clase qué pregunta responde cada detalle nuevo.

learn.rule: Ask who, what, when, where, and why. Each answer adds a detail and makes the sentence stronger.
learn.ruleEs: Pregunta quién, qué, cuándo, dónde y por qué. Cada respuesta agrega un detalle y fortalece la oración.
learn.model: The young painter mixed bright colors in her studio before the gallery opened.
learn.notice: The kernel is The painter mixed colors. Details tell who (young), where (in her studio), and when (before the gallery opened).

items.prompt: Which question does the detail at the museum answer about the artist?
items.text: The artist displayed her sculpture at the museum.
items.why: At the museum names a place, so it answers Where?
items.whyEs: At the museum nombra un lugar, así que responde Where? (dónde).

items.prompt: Which question does the detail to show how the sea feels answer?
items.text: The painter used swirling blue lines to show how the sea feels.
items.why: To show how the sea feels is the artist's reason, so it answers Why?
items.whyEs: To show how the sea feels es la razón de la artista, así que responde Why? (por qué).

items.prompt: Check every detail that tells when the band practiced.
items.why: When details tell the time. In the music room tells where, and for the audience tells why.
items.whyEs: Los detalles de cuándo dicen el tiempo. In the music room dice dónde y for the audience dice por qué.

items.prompt: Choose the detail that tells where the students hung their paintings.
items.model: The students hung their paintings on the hallway wall so everyone could see.
items.why: On the hallway wall names a place, so it answers Where?
items.whyEs: On the hallway wall nombra un lugar, así que responde Where?

items.prompt: Which is the strongest expansion of the kernel sentence The drummer played?

options.text: The drummer played in the park.
The young drummer played a steady beat in the park during the festival last Sunday.

items.why: This sentence tells who (young), what (a steady beat), where (in the park), and when (during the festival last Sunday).
items.whyEs: Esta oración dice quién (young), qué (a steady beat), dónde (in the park) y cuándo (during the festival last Sunday).

items.prompt: Choose the detail that tells who, then the detail that tells when.
items.model: The young dancers practiced the routine before the show.
items.why: The young dancers tells who, and before the show tells when. Each detail answers a different question.
items.whyEs: The young dancers dice quién y before the show dice cuándo. Cada detalle responde una pregunta distinta.

write.prompt: Expand the kernel sentence. Tell when and where, and add a reason if you can.
write.promptEs: Expande la oración base. Di cuándo y dónde, y agrega una razón si puedes.
write.model: The young singer performed a new song on the school stage during the spring concert because she wanted to share her music.

familyTalk.en: Pick a song or a picture you love. Say one detail each: who, what, when, where, why.
familyTalk.es: Elijan una canción o una imagen que les guste. Digan un detalle cada uno: quién, qué, cuándo, dónde, por qué.

teacherTip.en: Let students swap kernels and expand a partner's sentence, then compare which questions each writer answered.
teacherTip.es: Deja que los estudiantes intercambien oraciones base y expandan la de un compañero; luego comparen qué preguntas respondió cada escritor.
